title: Catalog
description: One install of a catalog, database, API or service that serves Swedish data.

id.description: Host of the canonical URL, plus the path when one host carries several installs. Lower case, no scheme, no www.

owner.description: Organisation id the data belongs to. Missing only while unresolved; the report lists those.

operator.description: Organisation id that runs the install, when it is not the owner.

status.description: The best result among the endpoints, as the liveness check or dataportal.se's harvest found it. Set by the build.

description.description: Short text by language, as the registers give it.

license.description: Licence URI the catalog declares for its contents as a whole.

protocol.description: Id in protocols.json; one protocol is one collector adapter.

url.description: Base URL the adapter starts from.

language.description: Languages the endpoint serves, when the protocol splits by language.

support.description: Overrides the protocol's support for this install only.

date.description: When the current result was first observed.
